code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 0 and (yy, xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            objects.append(cells)
    objects.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    masks = []
    for cells in objects[:2]:
        y0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
        x0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
        y1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
        x1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
        cellset = set(cells)
        masks.append([[int((y0 + y, x0 + x) in cellset) for x in range(x1 - x0 + 1)]
                      for y in range(y1 - y0 + 1)])
    a, b = masks
    width = max(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
    height = max(len(a), len(b))
    rows = []
    for y in range(height):
        out = []
        for x in range(width):
            va = a[y][x] if y < len(a) and x < len(a[0]) else 0
            vb = b[y][x] if y < len(b) and x < len(b[0]) else 0
            out.append(8 if va != vb else 0)
        if any(out):
            rows.append(out)
    return rows
'''
